approachQuestion.prompt:
Two adjacent unsigned W-bit storage words A and B represent a bit stream: positions 0..W-1 are A from lowest bit upward; positions W..2W-1 are B from lowest bit upward. Extract k bits starting at offset o and return them as a word with the first extracted bit in result position zero, clearing every higher result bit.

Constraints: 1 <= W <= 64; 0 <= o < W; 1 <= k <= W.
Example: W=8, A=176, B=13, o=6, k=5 -> 22 (10110 in binary). Edge case: W=8, A=176, B=13, o=0, k=8 -> 176.

Choose the best approach under these constraints.
constraints: W and k are parameters. W-bit logical shifts, AND and OR cost constant time. Shifts discard bits outside the word; all-ones means exactly W set bits. No wider concatenated word is available.
Inputs are read-only. Include all temporary storage and any call stack; exclude the supplied input and the returned output. No input copy is implicit.

options.text: Set t=A logically shifted right by o. If o+k>W, OR into t the word B shifted left by W-o. Finally AND t with the all-ones word logically shifted right by W-k.
options.feedback: Shifting A aligns the low segment. When the field crosses the boundary, B supplies its missing high segment. The final mask clears every bit above the requested k positions.

options.text: For each j from 0 through k-1, read stream position o+j from A or B as appropriate and set result bit j to that bit.
options.feedback: This handles all boundaries and returns the exact field, but reads positions individually when two word segments can be combined directly.

options.text: Align A and, on a crossing, merge B as above, but return the merged word without masking to k bits.
options.feedback: Bits beyond the requested field may remain. For W=8, A=255, B=0, o=0, k=3, it returns 255 instead of 7.

options.text: Treat B as stream positions 0..W-1 and A as positions W..2W-1, then extract the requested field.
options.feedback: That changes the stream definition. For W=8, A=1, B=0, o=0, k=1, it returns zero instead of one.

feedback.reason: Combine B only when the requested field crosses A's end.
details: Align the suffix of A to the low end. Only if the requested field crosses the word boundary, merge the required low portion of B into the upper positions. Construct a low-k-bit mask from a W-bit all-ones word and clear the unused high positions. The branch avoids a shift by W when o is zero.

complexityQuestion.prompt: For align-merge-mask, choose the tightest worst-case time and auxiliary-space pair. Let W be the payload width and k the extracted field length. Use word operations, with no wider word or intermediate bit array.

feedback.reason: One or two word segments require a fixed number of shifts and masks.
details: A fixed number of shifts and mask operations handles either one or two word segments. Only the merged word and mask are auxiliary; there is no array, wider concatenation or recursion.
